[quote=dhornaper;60768232][b][u]Announcement from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs[/u][/b]

The Government of President Fereydun Khan of Dhornaper is pleased to see the withdrawal of Thyven from the continued occupation of Sal-Baliz' territory which has been objectionable from the beginning but even more so now after Sal Baliz has a government capable of governing itself.

The government also supports the statement by our ally, the Islamic Sultante of Baladullah, and will reiterate their call for greater Shamatine cooperation and defence of our domestic affairs. The government of Fereydun Khan of Dhornaper will also join the Islamic Sultante of Baladullah in defending any imperialist encroachment of Shamatine soil. Shamat belongs to its peoples, as diverse as they are, who all have the united goal of ensuring our freedom and independence.

Signed,
Jalayer Khan, Minister of Foreign Affairs[/quote]

[nation]Dhornaper[/nation]
[nation]Baladullah[/nation]

[i][b]-Official Invite to the Shamat Security Pact-[/b]
[/i]
[i]To the Governments of Dhornaper and Baladullah,
[/i]
The Shamat Security Pact (SSP) formally invites your nations to enter membership discussions with our alliance. The SSP is committed to mutual defense, regional stability, and coordinated (anti-neo-colonial) security efforts. We believe your participation would strengthen our collective capabilities and deepen cooperation across our region and continent. We also believe this would strengthen your relations between nations already inside the pact. 

Membership in the SSP offers shared defense planning, central economic cooperation, and joint operational support, with more to come. We invite your appointed representatives to attend a forthcoming briefing session, where details of membership requirements and benefits will be presented.

We look forward to your response and to the possibility of welcoming Dhornaper and Baladullah into the Pact.

[b]With Respect,
The Secretariat and Nations of the Shamat Security Pact[/b]

[quote=the_crystalline_empire;60761891]Piter and Erjk listened to Terassis conversation with polite nods, admiring the architecture, not speaking yet. However upon Pilato speaking, Erjk would reply.

Greetings Don Pilato, I am Erjk Malbern, chairman of the Communist Party of North Thýven and First Chairman of the First Council, and this is Piter Drømm, Father of the Federation,

Piter gave an embarrassed look at Pilato upon the use of the title Father of the Federation, especially since he had been ousted by Malben only a week earlier.[/quote]
"[i]Lo[/i] Pilato, comrades. I'd rather not be mistaken for [i]Ponzio Pilato[/i]." Argo says, only half-joking because of his deep Catholicism. "Terrasi, since you've taken the liberty of showing our guests the Municipio lobby already, I might as well let you show them into the Conference too."

"Gotcha!" Terrasi quickly replied, walking off unceremoniously, expecting the Thyvenics to follow.

Away from the central lobby, Terrasi walked through the huge wooden doors that formed the northern section of the room. Flanking the door on either side were the two patrons of the general vicinity. On the right, a statue of Saint Andrew, for Sant'Andrea Street in which the Municipio was located. On the left, Saint Longinus with the Holy Lance, pointing directly towards the hammer and sickle monument, as if to allude to the viewer that the manifestation of socialism was the divine reckoning of all existence.

"Be quiet though, a session's in order..." Terrasi hushed, pushing the doors and revealing behind what seemed to be a massive general assembly, almost similar in design to the chambers of the International Accord. Inside, delegates were busy debating on a motion that had been called some time before their arrival. A man could be seen occupying the center stage of the chamber, seemingly busy taking attendance for the meeting.

Terrasi guided the men and Lo Pilato to a seat at the uppermost row of the chamber where they could find privacy. There, Terrasi finally put down her dense stack of papers onto a chair.

"Should I tell these gentlemen about the chamber next?"

"Not yet." Lo Pilato said, looking at the two of them. "So... Thyvenics, welcome once again to Citharo. This is where the Conference of Discussions typically takes place, though make no mistake, we aren't currently in session. This is just our Standing Presidium conducting administrative business. The Second Conference will come later, when the dust from the war in Astanir has settled and we have ensured the people's victory over fascism. Before that can be done though, we've taken the liberty of first clearing out the backlog of other revolutionary struggles that have required our intervention. Thyven is one of them, though woe are we that we know so little in the end despite our liberal use of memoranda to guide your revolution towards our line."

Hello everyone! This is Massanikos, I am looking to run the first ever (to my knowledge) Erene Olympic Games. Being that I am a Greek Inspired Nation, I think it is fitting. If you would like to participate in our games, reply to this message. 

[b]If you would like to host the games in your nation.[/b] I need to know the name of the City that will host the game. Your full national name, and information regarding the stability of your nation. Be prepared to write up a paragraph, at least, to explain why we should host it in your city. 

Please let me know if you have any questions. 

[sub] For simplicity, all nations will contend in all events. [/sub] [/quote]

Χαίρετε και καλώς ήρθατε!  
 

--- 

As a nation shaped by the combined heritage of Greek and German culture and civilization, the Kingdom of Ekpatanus is honored to declare its readiness and enthusiasm to host the 2027 Erene Olympic Games. We proudly propose the historic and magnificent city of Zephyropolis as the venue.  

Thanks to our strong tourism industry, we possess all the necessary infrastructure to accommodate this prestigious event. The Kingdom of Ekpatanus can guarantee the comfort, convenience, and security of all participants, audiences, and representatives from every nation.

Nation: The Kingdom of Ekpatanus  
City: Zephyropolis

While Drømm admired the architecture silently, his head turning on a swivel at the beauty of the moment, Malben, ever the politician and revolutionary would speak,

Firstly, we thank you for your memorandae, they have provided a clean blueprint by which we can adapt to the Citharo line, now if you shall permit my long tonguedness (A saying for which means he was about to go into a speech of dialectalism) I shall now enlighten you of the matter of Thýven.

The matter that currently stands is that Thýven is a nation of disunity at the present, torn between the old order, the moderates, and the revolution. It is a symptom of the fact that true unity has never been established in Thýven, which long held to either autocracy or devolution, thereby creating a strange fusion of autonomy and nationalism.

It is thus that I find, as noted in my memo, that the centralisation of the revolution is impossible without causing further discord. Of course it isnt a question of willingness but one of order, for the old order believes itself semi-secure under federalism, though they are wising up to the present moment that the people are turning, but if they for a moment believe themselves to be in danger, my position is at danger, for they can seize upon the disorder and make unto themselves the victors,

[b]NEUE REPUBLIK OLYMPIC GAMES BID[/b]

Along with participating in the Olympics, the Republik offers for the Erene Olympic Games to be held in the city of Neudresden within the Republic. Neudresden International Airport, with eleven terminal buildings, is fully capable of bringing in international spectators for the event, along with the city's robust highway and metro system. Within the city and its surroundings, there are significant sports venues for all events. In particular, the Graf Frederick aquatic facilities in the city comprise both the necessary diving facilities as well as the 50-meter Olympic standard pool lanes.  On top of all standard events, the city of Neudresden is also uniquely positioned to hold winter events. Nearby ski resorts in the Büdingen Alps are ready to help host skiing events as well as sliding centers that are ready to host bobsledding.

[b]location: one of the coastal towns in south Valddera[/b]
[i]through the mud the DBT ratel goes, several trucks full with infantry in tow behind. The tank commander, lieutenant Abe Maerten is leaning against the cupola and looks through his binoculars at a destroyed town. He orders the tank driver to stop and the Ratel comes to a stop. He then goes back inside the tank and grabs his radio, "alright folks we reached our destination." The gunner, Wijnant looks through the tank periscope and says, "where even are we?" Abe looks down at the map besides him then looks back up, "i am not even going to pronounce the name because i can't read whatever language they speak here but this town is close to one of the major cities in this ruined country." The tank and trucks behind drive into the town and the driver remarks, "why are we even driving around here? Wasn't the ISV wiped out in this area some time ago?"[/i] 
Abe: [i]"Officially yes, but guerilla fighters are still holding out here, a large part of them child soldiers being forced into this."[/i]
Driver: [i]"the child soldier part seems kinda fcked up to me."[/i]
Abe: [i]"that's why almost everyone that went to this shthole with us always vandalizes the graves of these ISV terrorists i heard..."[/i]
[i]The Ratel then stops at the entrance to the town square and then an loud explosion rings through the tank and Abe shouts through the radio, "ambush!" Behind the Ratel the infantry jumps out the back of the trucks and look around where the explosion came from, gunfire then begins from some partially destroyed houses and Abe says, "those houses at the right! Load HESH now!" The turret rotates to one of the buildings and fires, the HESH shell hits the wall of one of the buildings and detonates, creating a wave of deadly spall inside the building. The infantry then returns fire while another HESH shell is pushed into the gun breach and Wijnant fires again at another part of the building.[/i]
[i]The gun fire starts to die out after almost 2 minutes and a few infantry soldiers move towards the now fully destroyed homes and peek inside. A few ISV child soldiers look at them slightly scared and one of the soldiers shouts back to the rest, "We found some children here! Come take a look." Other soldiers gather at house and one remarks, "I think these are the only ones that still live."
"Why?"
"Because the rest are dead as fck dumbass."
Another soldier says, "We need a translator for this...or does anyone know conveniently the language of this place?" 
The other soldiers shrug their soldiers and one at the back says, "should we take them back?" A few look at him and one says "of course we take these kids back! These children aren't like the ISV scum we normally fight."
Wijnant meanwhile is looking at the damage with the Ratel driver and Wijnant says to Abe, "we had luck dude..the HEATFS shell had missed the ammo compartment at the bottom with a few inches..hell i don't know how we even survived with zero injuries." Abe shrugs and looks behind him, "we figure that out another time, lets go back now with these kids to base and se see further."
As the infantry goes back into the trucks with the now captured child soldiers The ratel turns around and starts driving back with the rest to their Base with the evening sun in the sky.[/i][/spoiler]
